recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Revisit only if a future current examples-json.zip reintroduces one of these concrete missing-field defects; any retrospective R4-patch repair would need to target the historical publication/release process rather than this current source branch.
issue_request: FHIR-20387 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-I. It reported that the R4 4.0.0 examples-json.zip artifact was missing SearchParameter.base on CodeSystem/ValueSet extension search parameter JSON files, StructureDefinition.type on definition/event/fivews/request JSON files, and Questionnaire.item.linkId on generated resource-definition questionnaire JSON files, with the fix applied for R5.
initial_application: No FHIR-20387-keyed core commit was found. Later generator/source maintenance and publication refactoring appear to have resolved the current surfaces: R5/current logical model JSON includes StructureDefinition.type, R5 generated questionnaire JSON has no missing linkId values, and R5/current core examples-json.zip no longer contains the named CodeSystem/ValueSet extension search parameter JSON files.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread confirms the original report and shows the resolution context: Lloyd McKenzie said the examples should follow the standard, while Grahame Grieve questioned the base/type reports but agreed the missing linkId was an error. Current core still builds the downloads page, logical models, and Questionnaire; the named extension search parameters were later moved to the FHIR Extension Pack where they include base and type. Related examples/archive audits are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current generated/publication surfaces checked for this issue do not show a current core defect: definition.json, event.json, fivews.json, and request.json carry StructureDefinition.type; current source Questionnaire examples contain linkId on every item and the current examples-json.zip no longer publishes the old resource-definition *-questionnaire.json files; and the moved extension search parameter definitions are correct in the Extension Pack rather than editable in this core checkout.
